items.q: he can just sit behind a set of drums and he will remind you of Jimmy Fox, Jimmy Fox the baseball player

ctx.x: it's Sonny Greer. But nobody looks behind a set of drums - he can just sit behind a set of drums and he will remind you of Jimmy Fox, Jimmy Fox the baseball player, that looked like a baseball. Well, Mr. Lovett looks like drums, you see, and I'm speaking in the jazz idiom.
...I'm sure in your travels you must have come in contact with Wally Bishop?
